exposure: glycemic control (glycated hemoglobin, time in range, time above range, time below range)
outcome: body composition (fat mass index, fat mass percentage, free fat mass percentage, total water content, extracellular water, intracellular water, basal metabolic rate)
cohort: The study included 46 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes and 92 healthy children and adolescents, matched on the basis of pubertal status.
finding: Children and adolescents with well-managed type 1 diabetes showed comparable body composition measurements but a lower phase angle compared to healthy peers, with those practicing extracurricular physical activity having phase angle values comparable to healthy subjects.
